paragraphs.text: It is a warm Sunday morning. All the animals are busy. They are cleaning the big tree square. A music show is coming soon.
paragraphs.translation: 这是一个温暖的星期天早晨。动物们都很忙。他们正在打扫大树广场。一场音乐会很快就要开始了。

paragraphs.text: Little Frog is sitting on a green leaf. He is holding a small red drum. He wants to sing a song. His hands are cold and shaking.
paragraphs.translation: 小青蛙坐在一片绿叶上。他手里拿着一个小红鼓。他想唱一首歌。他的双手又冷又抖。

paragraphs.text: Rabbit is climbing up the big tree. "You can sing well, Frog," says Rabbit. "I like your sweet, happy voice. We are all your friends."
paragraphs.translation: 兔子正爬上那棵大树。“青蛙，你能唱得很好，”兔子说。“我喜欢你那甜甜的、快乐的声音。我们都是你的朋友。”

paragraphs.text: Duck is bringing a little bell. Bear is putting chairs in long rows. They are working and singing together. Everyone is happy to help.
paragraphs.translation: 鸭子带来了一只小铃铛。熊把椅子排成长长的一排排。他们一边干活一边唱歌。大家都很乐意帮忙。

paragraphs.text: Now Frog is standing on the stage. His friends are smiling at him. He is singing a happy song. All the animals are clapping.
paragraphs.translation: 现在青蛙站在了舞台上。他的朋友们都冲着他微笑。他正在唱一首快乐的歌。所有的动物都在鼓掌。

paragraphs.text: Frog is not afraid now. He likes singing with his friends. "Thank you, my good friends!" he says. "We can sing together next time!"
paragraphs.translation: 青蛙现在不害怕了。他喜欢和朋友们一起唱歌。“谢谢你们，我的好朋友们！”他说。“下次我们可以一起唱！”

quiz.question: What are the animals doing in the morning?
quiz.audioText: What are the animals doing in the morning?
He is holding a small red drum.

quiz.sentenceWithBlank: Rabbit is ___ up the big tree.
quiz.audioText: Rabbit is climbing up the big tree.
